capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Fiat 2013 specification: 24 kWh, 97 cells, 364 V. Same pack 2013-2019 (no change documented).

chemistry.notes: Samsung SDI NCM (NMC) cells, 97 cells, 364 V (also the 2013 column of the 2013-vs-2024 comparison page).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Fiat's specification describes the pack's four automatic thermal modes (equalization, passive cooling, active cooling, active heating) and J1772 AC charging only; no user/navigation battery preconditioning feature and no DC fast charging. Not confirmed by an owner's manual. No maker launch of battery preconditioning could be cited; moot for a car with no DC port (dc_max_kw 0), so owner decision requested.

dc_max_kw.notes: No DC fast-charging connector, standard or optional (Fiat 2013 spec lists none; Wikipedia; Green Cars Compare). EV Specifications lists 40 kW CCS1 for the 2019 page; contradicted by the others and not used.
